thread:
Lina: Quick heads-up — RC freeze in ~8h. Need final thumbs on version bump (v1.14.3?), changelog, and announce draft. Planning to post to #announcements at 2026-03-18 15:00 UTC. Any blockers?

Matt: Version bump is on release/v1.14.3 — I pushed the branch a few minutes ago. Waiting on changelog PR to merge.

Sophia: Changelog PR is #987. Left one question about the db migration note — want to make sure it's clear for SRE.

Carla: Migration is just an index add, no downtime expected. Pushed a follow-up to #987 to reword.

Lina: Nice. @Matt can you run the smoke suite after the merge? If green we'll tag and push.

Matt: K — starting smoke now. Command: `./scripts/smoke.sh --suite core && ./scripts/smoke.sh --suite integrations`

Matt: Smoke output: all core tests passed, 2 flaky integration tests (known flakies). Nothing blocking.

ops-bot: Deploy healthcheck scheduled: 2026-03-18T15:05:00Z. Expected ETA 15:15 UTC.

Lina: Draft announce is in #eng-releases/drafts — pls skim. I'll post to #announcements after the tag. Quick checklist I want ticked: version bump, changelog entry, docs update, support notification, and deploy healthcheck green.

Carla: LGTM on the draft. Tiny wording nit: call out the batching perf improvement in the bullet list.

Sophia: +1 to Carla. Also reminder: cutoff for docs PRs is in ~2h. If anyone plans to add release notes to docs site, please submit today.

Matt: Tagging now: `git tag -a v1.14.3 -m "Release v1.14.3" && git push origin v1.14.3` :white_check_mark:

Lina: Tagged and release artifact uploaded to the internal registry. Preparing to post to #announcements in 30m with the scheduled window. No slip expected. :rocket:

ops-bot: Deploy started. Monitor: https://ci.redwood.example/deploys/17635 — streaming logs.

Ben: Notifying Support & Customer Success about the 15:00 UTC window and the minimal risk migration. Added the Slack snippet for the support team.

Lina: Thanks all — will post final ETA + rollout notes in 20m. If anything comes up reply in this thread. :thumbsup:
